title: Prove unacknowledged-message reminders on released harnesses
text: Source tests prove a reminder per backoff on every claude, codex and cursor surface inject event, reminder rendering and settlement, and seat receipts for handed-over steering mail. No deployed check observes a real Cursor or Claude session receiving a reminder, or a re-acquired seat injecting parked mail: forcing either would leave real fleet mail unacknowledged or move a live seat. Status stays observed until ordinary fleet operation records that evidence.
